findings.title: Merged-PR template helpers are added to the wrong class
findings.body: _truncate_title, get_environment_info, and get_merged_pr_single_issue_template are added to CommitContextIntegration, but GitHubPRCommentWorkflow and GitlabPRCommentWorkflow call self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template(...) and self.get_environment_info(...) on the PR-comment workflow object, which does not inherit from CommitContextIntegration. Additionally, get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(...), but _truncate_title was defined on CommitContextIntegration, not PRCommentWorkflow. Generating a merged-PR suspect-issue comment will therefore raise AttributeError instead of producing the comment.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table widget renders empty data instead of the query result
findings.body: When the organization has the use-table-widget-visualization feature, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded columns={[]} and tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}}. It discards result.data, result.meta, fields, eventView, fieldAliases, custom field renderers, and loading state that are passed to StyledSimpleTableChart in the non-flagged branch, so every dashboard table widget behind the flag will appear empty.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while searching
findings.body: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES ('is_segment', 'project_id', 'received') is only checked inside the branch that runs when searchQuery is non-empty. When the search box is empty, sortedAndFilteredAttributes returns sortAttributes(attributes) without filtering, so the supposedly hidden attributes are still displayed by default and only disappear after the user types a search query.

findings.title: Browser reports with neither age nor timestamp are accepted
findings.body: BrowserReportSerializer makes both age and timestamp required=False, and validate_age/validate_timestamp only reject the case where both are present. A report with neither field therefore passes validation and is counted, even though the two supported Reporting API specs each require one of these fields and the previous dataclass required timestamp. The validators also use truthiness (self.initial_data.get('age')), so age=0 does not trigger the mutual-exclusion check when timestamp is also present.

findings.title: Error events are paired with error IDs by zipping an unordered nodestore result
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids), then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). get_multi returns a mapping keyed by node id and does not guarantee insertion in error_ids order, and missing nodes are absent rather than represented by None. Consequently IDs can be paired with another event's data, and when any event is missing the zip shifts all subsequent pairings and silently drops trailing errors instead of filtering only the missing entry by its node id, corrupting the error context sent to Seer.
